ValidationRule.description: 仕様: Accounting 第10.2節。各スロットと科目の勘定区分を一致させる。
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(DebitSlotKey__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(DebitAccount__c)), CASE( TEXT(DebitSlotKey__c), "AccountsReceivable", "Asset", "ContractAsset", "Asset", "Cash", "Asset", "DeferredRevenue", "Liability", "TaxPayable", "Liability", "UnappliedCash", "Liability", "SuspensePayment", "Asset", "Revenue", "Revenue", "FxGain", "Revenue", "FxLoss", "Expense", "OtherIncome", "Revenue", "OtherExpense", "Expense", "UNKNOWN" ) <> TEXT(DebitAccount__r.AccountType__c) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(CreditSlotKey__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(CreditAccount__c)), CASE( TEXT(CreditSlotKey__c), "AccountsReceivable", "Asset", "ContractAsset", "Asset", "Cash", "Asset", "DeferredRevenue", "Liability", "TaxPayable", "Liability", "UnappliedCash", "Liability", "SuspensePayment", "Asset", "Revenue", "Revenue", "FxGain", "Revenue", "FxLoss", "Expense", "OtherIncome", "Revenue", "OtherExpense", "Expense", "UNKNOWN" ) <> TEXT(CreditAccount__r.AccountType__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: スロットと科目の勘定区分が一致していません。
